fomod.Name: CTD - Crash to Desktop Reporter
fomod.Author: ezmode.games
fomod.Description:
Automatic crash reporting for Cyberpunk 2077.
When your game crashes, CTD captures detailed diagnostic information including your mod list and crash location. This data is sent to ctd.ezmode.games where it's analyzed to help identify mod conflicts and compatibility issues.
Features: - Automatic crash detection via Windows SEH - Captures installed RED4ext and redscript mods - Scans archive mods for fingerprinting - Identifies crash location in loaded modules - Privacy-focused: no personal data collected - Lightweight: minimal performance impact
Requires RED4ext.
